LESSON: HADITH ON: RESPECT

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.3: Hadith on: Respect

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Hadith on: Respect. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What is respect?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Hadith on: Respect
2. Practise Hadith on: Respect at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Hadith on: Respect

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Hadith on: Respect
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Hadith on: Respect. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Hadith on: Respect at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Hadith on: Respect at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Hadith on: Respect
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Hadith on: Respect. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Hadith on: Respect using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Hadith on: Respect in the examples.
2. Explain Hadith on: Respect to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Hadith on: Respect.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith on: Respect using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Hadith on: Respect important for a Grade 3 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Organize learners in class, groups, or your elders? of the Hadith pairs, to give situations when they accord respect to elders. c) Appreciate the importance of the
2. Learners read repeatedly the hadith on virtue of respect as a way of respect displayed /written on the board abiding by the teachings of Hadith for memorisation of the Prophet (S.A.W)

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Hadith on: Respect
2. Practise Hadith on: Respect at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Hadith on: Respect

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
